title: EliteTable：面向可执行控制策略的自改进程序搜索
summary: EliteTable 是一种由大语言模型引导的自改进程序搜索算法，使用固定容量的高分方案表来指导新提案、编辑和重组。在六个 Gymnasium 控制任务上评估，多数任务中候选分数中位数随代数提升，部分任务中获胜方案的增益可迁移到新回合。
summary_en: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by LLMs that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits, and remixes. Evaluated on six Gymnasium control tasks, candidate-score medians rose across generations in all six, and selected-winner gains transferred to held-out episodes in some tasks.
